name: Lebanese Pan-Fried Fish (Sayadieh) with Spiced Rice, Caramelized Onions, Toasted Almonds & Cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until caramelized and very soft, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then set aside to drain.
When the onions are done, add spices to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, 30-60 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp coriander, ground
½ tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp turmeric, ground
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add drained rice and water to the pot, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat. Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the pot, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add almonds and cook, stirring frequently, until toasted and fragrant, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
⅓ cup slivered almonds

instructions.primary_message: Pat cod dry with paper towels, cut into 6 portions, and place on a plate; season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g cod fillet
½ tsp paprika
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place flour on another plate. Working with one piece at a time, dredge cod in the flour on both sides.

Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add the cod and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.

Meanwhile, wash and dry cilantro; shave cilantro leaves off the stems, then discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. When the rice is done, fluff with a fork. Add half of the cilantro to the pot, then stir to combine. (Reserve remaining cilantro for serving.)
Wash, dry, and cut lemon into wedges.
Transfer rice to a platter. Arrange cod over the rice, then sprinkle with reserved cilantro and toasted almonds. Serve with lemon wedges for squeezing and enjoy!
